buildSteps.step: 2. The catalog: tag data shape, author meta, and pure selectors
buildSteps.detail: Sibling registry, never on the Saint type (saints.ts must stay import-free). catalog.ts holds closed lists, each item {id, label (English, equal to en.json), labelKey}: THEMES grouped as passions [gluttony, lust, avarice, anger, sorrow, acedia, vainglory, pride] (Evagrius/Cassian order; 'hatred' folds into anger), virtues [humility, love, prayer, repentance, watchfulness, patience, almsgiving, chastity], life [grief, death, marriage, temptation, work, suffering, fear], seasons [lent, holy-week, pascha, nativity-fast, nativity, theophany, transfiguration, dormition]; TRADITIONS [greek, latin, syriac, egypt, antioch, russian, serbian, romanian, georgian] (the last three empty today); ERAS [apostolic (1st c.), early (2nd to 3rd c.), councils (4th to 8th c.), byzantine (9th to 15th c.), after-byzantium (16th to 19th c.), modern (20th c. on)]; FORMS [treatise, homilies, letters, life, sayings, hymns, scripture, retelling]. Types: `type WorkKey = `${saintSlug}/${workSlug}``; `type ThemeTag = { theme: ThemeId; sections?: [from: number, to: number][]; basis: string }` (sections are Section.n ranges when only part of the work treats it; basis is one internal line for the clergy review, never shown); `type ReadingEntry = { key: WorkKey; by: string | null (author saint slug, null when anonymous, e.g. Way of a Pilgrim); about?: string (subject saint slug for a Life, e.g. Life of Antony by athanasius-the-great about anthony-the-great); sameAs?: WorkKey (duplicate registration, shown once); form: FormId; scope: 'complete' | 'selections'; themes: ThemeTag[]; tradition?: TraditionId; era?: EraId (override the author's); begin?: true (Where to begin / new to Orthodoxy); featured?: { feast?: true; seasons?: SeasonKey[] }; review: 'pending-clergy' }`. `AUTHOR_META: Record<saintSlug, { tradition: TraditionId; era: EraId; desert?: true }>` for the 75 authors. Cover subject = about ?? by. select.ts (pure, client-safe): rowsFor(entries, stats), moreLikeThis(key, n) by theme overlap, then same author, then same tradition and era, excluding sameAs; searchCatalog(q, filters, labels) diacritic-folded over title, subtitle, author name and byname, theme/tradition/era labels in the reader's language and Work.topics; lengthBucket(minutes) at under 20, 20 to 60, 60 to 180, over 180; featuredFor(day, calendarMode, candidates). Tests: every SAINTS work has exactly one entry (completeness like iconRights); every sections range exists in the JSON; sameAs targets exist and are not chained; every theme/tradition/era/form label equals en.json and has words in all 21 catalogs; no tag without basis; byline honesty: an entry with by set and form not retelling must not be byPurify per workAuthorship(), or the test names it. Tagging is editorial work done by reading the sections, marked review: pending-clergy, nothing invented.

buildSteps.step: 3. Reading stats, generated once and held fresh
buildSteps.detail: scripts/reading-stats.mjs reads data/saints/**.json and writes data/reading/stats.json: {key: {words, minutes (WORDS_PER_MINUTE 180 from lib/bible/readability.ts, minimum 1), sections, voices}}. Committed, so neither build has a pre-step and the 31 MB corpus is never read at request time. lib/reading/stats.ts imports it. stats.test.ts recomputes and fails on drift (one place to rerun). Minutes display: under 60 as today.minRead '{count} min', else reading.work.hoursMinutes.

About 75 new keys in all 21 catalogs (drafted, waiting on native readers like the 1.6 small labels). labels.test.ts mirrors lib/i18n/__tests__/smallLabels.test.ts for the data-level labelKeys that no literal t() call names. Keep reading.enterReadingRoom (export walk asserts it is absent from Discover). Retire reading.eyebrow, reading.popular, reading.enterDeeper, reading.nextRead only after export-walk check 20 moves to the new keys. No em dashes, sentence case, no all-caps.

buildSteps.step: 5. The shared Cover component and cover art resolution
buildSteps.detail:
Cover (server-safe, no hooks) props: {title, author (display name), icon: {src, focusY?} | null, art?: string | null (large web-hosted art, hero only), size: 'thumb' 48x72 | 'row' 112x168 phone, 148x222 tablet | 'grid' fluid | 'hero' 180 to 220 wide, shape: 'book' (2:3, default) | 'square' (1:1, for read-aloud Now Playing and chants later), priority?, className?}. Book shape: a dark plate (new token --color-plate near #17171b, same in both themes, like a physical book), 12px radius, 1px paper/10 hairline. The icon sits in a window at the top: inset 8px, about 58% of the height, 8px radius, object-cover with object-position 50% focusY% (default 18%, the NowPlayingSheet value), no wash or gradient over it. Under it the title in Lora (font-serif, a

, not a heading; 15px/1.2 at row size, 3-line clamp) and the author in DM Sans 11 to 12px paper/60, one line. Fallback when there is no settled icon (Jerome, Gregory the Dialogist, the Way of a Pilgrim, or any icon still unopened): no window, no halo, no initials, no glyph, no gradient; the title alone in Lora, larger (18px at row size, up to 5 lines), top aligned, the author under it. So a fallback cover still reads as part of the same set. The image is alt='' because the link's name carries title and author; loading=lazy and decoding=async except the hero. Square shape: the icon fills the square edge to edge, no text (the player prints the title). lib/reading/coverArt.ts: coverIconFor(entry) = SAINTS.iconUrl of (about ?? by), returned only when iconRightsFor(src) is a settled row, plus a FOCUS map per file for tall full-length icons; heroArtFor(entry) = the large web file when a row exists in the cover rights registry (step 11), with onError falling back to the bundled icon offline. Tests: an unverified file never reaches a cover; every focus key is a real file. CoverRow: h2 row title (globals set Lora), optional 'See all' text link with a mirrored ChevronLeft, ScrollRail of covers, 10px gap, 20px gutter, so a 390px phone shows 3 covers and a peek. Press feedback: the existing tap-press utility; any entrance motion uses motion-safe: only.

buildSteps.step: 6. Icon rights pass for the covers in use
buildSteps.detail: Open every icon that a cover will show and write its rights row (or replace it) the way iconRights.ts requires: alt describing the picture, work, artist, date, source, licence, evidence URL, inspectedOn. Start with the authors of the rows' first items (Athanasius, Chrysostom, Basil, Cassian, Mary of Egypt, Antony, Ignatius, Polycarp, Cyprian already settled, Isaac, Ephraim, Augustine, Seraphim). Replace john-chrysostom.jpg with a bust icon; treat john-cassian.jpg as suspect (possibly a living iconographer's work) until sourced. Find public-domain icons for Jerome and Gregory the Dialogist. Any new file under 200 KB and opened before it ships; UNVERIFIED_ICONS only shrinks. New icon files are small enough for the bundle only if the packed size allows; otherwise they go to the web folder of step 11.

buildSteps.step: 7. The reading room, one responsive screen
buildSteps.detail: page.tsx becomes one server shell (metadata, revalidate) that builds compact card data from entries + stats + coverArt (about 130 x 200 bytes) and renders <ReadingRoom>. No desktop twin, no t(m,...): <T> islands only. Delete components/mobile/ReadingMobile.tsx and components/reading/ContinueReading.tsx and NextRead.tsx once replaced. Order: MobileHeader(nav.reading) on phones; a search field (opens step 8); FeaturedWork hero (Cover hero size, title in Lora, author row with a 24px round crop of the icon, meta line 'minutes, era, tradition' separated by commas, the work's existing blurb, 'Start reading' white pill to /saints/x/y#s1 and the whole cover linking to the work page; picked client-side with useToday: the author's feast day, else the current season's featured list, else a weekly rotation through complete works with settled art; the server renders the same box at the same size so nothing jumps); Continue reading (works only, progress from step 9, links straight to #sN, hidden when empty); Because you read <title> (moreLikeThis of the last work, hidden without history); Where to begin (the curated POPULAR keys renamed WHERE_TO_BEGIN plus begin:true entries; keep the curated link test); The passions (8 chapter-level items in order, each the best verbatim reading, caption is the theme label, link to #s of its first section; e.g. anger = Cassian, Institutes Book 8, s157 to s178); The virtues; For life; the season (current or next: add seasonKey(date, mode) beside currentSeason so the row has an id and follows the Old Calendar setting); one row per tradition with at least 4 entries (Greek, Latin, Egypt today; Syriac and Russian join as works grow), with the tradition list also as chips; The Desert Fathers (Antony, Pimen, Isidora, Mary of Egypt, Cassian, Jerome's Paul, Hilarion and Malchus); Short reads (complete, mostly verbatim, under 20 minutes: Ignatius' seven epistles, Polycarp to the Philippians, the Martyrdom of Polycarp, the Paschal Homily, Life of Malchus); Also in the library (Councils, Topics, Florilegium, the existing DiscoverIndex rows). Tablet and desktop: the same rows with wider covers and ScrollRail arrows; the hero side by side (cover left, text right). Keep the masthead picture only if the mock wins it; drop OrnamentHeadpiece and the colophon in display serif. No arrow characters anywhere.

Tapping the search field turns the room into its search state in place: the field (Search icon from components/ui/icons), a ChipScroller of FilterPills (Theme, Author, Era, Length, Tradition, and Clear when any is set), and a results grid of covers (3 columns on a phone, 5 to 6 on tablet). Each chip opens one movable Sheet (components/ui/Sheet.tsx) listing its options with counts; theme options grouped (passions, virtues, life, seasons). State lives in the URL query (?q=&theme=&author=&era=&length=&tradition=), read client-side inside Suspense like /bible/multi, so a theme chip on a work page can link to /reading?theme=anger and Back restores the search. Empty state is one line (reading.empty.search). Search runs over the compact card data from step 7, no network.

buildSteps.step: 9. Progress that the Continue row can show
buildSteps.detail: lib/reading/progress.ts: localStorage purify:reading-progress = Record<WorkKey, {n, of, at, done?}>, no TTL, useSyncExternalStore like history.ts. WritingReader's existing debounced scheduleSave also writes progress (one call), and marks done at the last section instead of only clearing the position. lib/reader/position.ts stays as it is for resume. ContinueRow = history kind 'work' joined with progress, not done, most recent first, with a 2px neutral track under the cover (paper/15, fill paper/80): no colored stripe.

buildSteps.step: 10. The work page: a book header on the existing work route
buildSteps.detail: No new per-work route: 130 more pages would add several MB to a bundle at 84.4 of 85 MB packed. The book page is the top of /saints/[slug]/[work]. BookHeader is server-rendered in page.tsx above the reader (so the apps show it before the text file lands): Cover (hero size), title (the page's h1, moved out of WritingReader's header), author row (round icon crop + name, links to the saint page; 'By' or 'About' from workAuthorship() and the entry; 'Anonymous' for the Way of a Pilgrim), meta line (minutes, era, tradition, and 'Selections' when scope is selections), theme chips linking to /reading?theme=..., the existing blurb, and the primary pill: 'Start reading' to #s1, or 'Continue, <section title>' when a saved position exists. A 'Listen' pill appears only once a work has read-aloud audio (none today; no dead button, no 'coming soon'). ChaptersList replaces the desktop-only <details>: shown on every size, the first 6 sections then 'All N chapters' opening the existing MobileWorkPill contents Sheet; every section title stays in the DOM for long works (export-walk check 5 reads all 35 books of Morals on Job). MoreLikeThis (CoverRow of 10) at the foot after the last section, with a quiet 'Finished' line when progress is done: the next step pattern 4 asks for. Remove the silent jump on open in favour of the Continue pill (hash links from the Continue row still go straight in): needs his yes. Replace the › breadcrumb characters with the mirrored ChevronLeft.

buildSteps.step: 11. Large art from the web, kept out of the bundle
buildSteps.detail: Hero art only (about 12 featured works, 800px public-domain icons, each opened before it ships, under 200 KB). Put them in public/covers/ and append ['public','covers'] to the end of STASH_PATHS (never insert: slot-index recovery), so the website serves them and the apps load https://purifyapp.net/covers/<file> (passed from the server shell, where IS_STATIC_EXPORT is known); offline the hero falls back to the bundled icon. coverRights.ts uses the same seven rights fields as iconRights with a completeness test against readdir. Downloads need his yes. Measure build:android packed size before and after this whole area.

buildSteps.step: 12. Saint page writings as cover rows (the note 19 hook) and cleanup
